title: DatasourceConfig
description: Outer struct intentionally omits `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]`: `#[serde(flatten)]` + tagged enum + schemars produces a `oneOf` schema where each variant has `additionalProperties: false` and doesn't know about the outer struct's fields. Strict-deny here would cause every datasource YAML to fail schema validation. The inner `DatasourceKind` is also lax for the same reason; the other per-kind types (TableConfig, PageConfig, etc.) keep their strict-deny since they don't use flatten.

token.description: Optional pre-issued access token (JWT). Takes priority over `username`/`password`; authenticates via the SurrealDB `authenticate` RPC. `${VAR}`-substitutable. Used for SurrealDB Cloud instances, whose access token is brokered out of band.

username.description: Optional signin username (root or NS/DB user). Supports `${VAR}` references resolved from the environment — including secrets managed in the project `.env` — so credentials stay out of the committed inventory. Paired with `password`.

oneOf.description: Directory of CSV files. Each file under `path` becomes one table.
vantage-api-client backed; one datasource per remote service.

debug.description: When `true`, every REST request logs the URL it fetched and how many rows came back (visible in `list_logs`). A development aid for confirming pagination/filter params; leave off in normal use.

filter_strategy.description: How conditions that don't fill a URL path `{placeholder}` are applied. `query` (default) sends them as `?field=value`; `client` applies them as in-memory row filters after the fetch — for APIs that filter only by path segments and reject/ignore unknown query params (e.g. the Mercury control-API, whose deployments endpoint takes `product_id` in the path and whose CLI filters version/env client-side).

no_pagination.description: Set to `true` for APIs that don't paginate — no `_page`/`_limit` query params are sent, and the perpetual grid stops after the first chunk. Required for FastAPI/ Pydantic services that treat unknown query params as strict filters (a `_page=1` request would return `[]`).

pagination.description: Pagination query-param names. Omit for the JSON-Server default (`?_page=&_limit=`, 1-based pages — the JSONPlaceholder shape).

response_key.description: Envelope key the row array lives under — e.g. `results` for an API that returns `{ "count": …, "results": [ … ] }` (Launch Library 2, DRF, …). Omit for a bare `[ … ]` response body.

total_key.description: Envelope field holding the grand total of matching rows — e.g. `count` for `{ "count": 7400, "results": [ … ] }`. When set (alongside `pagination`), the grid loads rows lazily on scroll and sizes its scrollbar to the full total instead of fetching a single server-default page. Omit for APIs with no total field (the grid then loads only the first page).

oneOf.description: GraphQL endpoint backed by `vantage_api_client::GraphqlApi`. One datasource per endpoint. `dialect` controls how filter arguments are rendered: `generic` (flat `{ field: v }` — the SpaceX-style public-API shape, default) or `hasura` (`{ field: { _eq: v } }`, full operator coverage). `filter_arg` overrides the argument name the dialect would pick (`find` for generic, `where` for hasura).

vantage-aws backed (JSON-1.1 RPC: CloudWatch Logs, ECS, …). All credential fields are optional; missing pieces fall back to env vars (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `AWS_REGION`) and then `~/.aws/credentials` `[default]`. Set `profile` to read a named section instead of `[default]`.

profile.description: Named AWS credentials profile (`~/.aws/credentials`). Takes priority over `access_key`/`secret_key` but can be combined with `region` to override the profile's region.

oneOf.description: `vantage_aws::dynamodb::DynamoDB` backed. Same auth surface as [`Self::Aws`] but builds tables on top of the typed DynamoDB data source — that means `AttributeValue` envelopes are unwrapped on the way out (so columns render as plain strings / numbers / bools instead of `{"S": "..."}` shapes), and `params:` becomes server-side `FilterExpression` `eq` conditions instead of being stuffed into the request body. Tables on this datasource set `table:` to the DynamoDB table name directly (e.g. `ddb-mercplat-api`), not the `protocol/array_key:service/target` triple.

`vantage-kubernetes` backed — the cluster's REST API as tables. Connects via the ambient kubeconfig (current context, honouring `$KUBECONFIG`) or the in-cluster service account. Each table's `table:` is the resource API path (`api/v1/pods`, `apis/apps/v1/deployments`); `params:` (e.g. `namespace: demo`) bake in as client-side `eq` filters.

context.description: kubeconfig context to use. Reserved — the current context is used today; set to document intent.

namespace.description: Default namespace for namespaced convenience paths.

oneOf.description: `vantage-cmd` backed — fetches data by executing a local CLI. `command` is the locked binary (e.g. `mercury`); per-table Rhai scripts (the table's `cmd:` block) build the argv, run it, and parse stdout into rows. The script can never change *which* binary runs, only its arguments. The child process gets a cleared environment plus the declared `env`; `pass_path` (default `true`) additionally forwards `PATH`/`HOME` so the binary and its own config (credentials, tokens) resolve.

`vantage-faker` backed — a synthetic, in-memory datasource that generates realistic rows (via the `fake` crate) and, for the `fifo` effect, keeps mutating them over time. No external connection. Values come from each column's name (`email`, `city`, …) then its type. These datasource-level fields are the defaults; a table's `faker:` block overrides them per table.

backfill.description: How much history the `live_folder` sim replays at full speed on startup, as a duration string (`30m`, `1h`). Default `1h`, so the tree is populated before the first real-time tick.

band.description: Rubber-band half-width as a percentage of baseline. Default `5`.

count.description: Row count for the `static` effect. Default 20.

effect.description: `static` (generate `count` rows once; the default), `fifo` (insert one row per `interval`, newest-first, expiring each after a random duration in `[retention_lo, retention_hi]`), `pulse` (a keyed rubber-band aggregate feed — see the `pulse` fields below), or `live_folder` (a synthetic, constantly-growing log-folder tree: each table is a path-parameterized listing family whose per-path listings all ride one shared sim).

interval.description: `fifo` insertion cadence as a duration string (`1s`, `500ms`). Default `1s`.

offline.description: Keys that periodically blip offline (frozen value, `live = "Offline"`).

rate.description: Per-key update cadence range (duration strings). Default `1s`–`3s`.

retention_hi.description: `fifo` maximum row lifetime before expiry. Default `15s`.

retention_lo.description: `fifo` minimum row lifetime before expiry. Default `8s`.

value_column.description: Column holding the current value on the aggregate table (e.g. `visitors`).

oneOf.description: Reads a bearer token from the macOS Keychain via `security find-generic-password -s <service> -a <account> -w`. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless `scheme` overrides the prefix (e.g. `scheme: ""` for raw, `scheme: "Token"`).

ApiFilterStrategy.description: How an `api-client` datasource applies conditions that don't fill a URL path `{placeholder}`. Maps to `vantage_api_client::FilterStrategy`.

oneOf.description: Apply as in-memory row filters after the fetch.

ApiPagination.description: Pagination query-param names for an `api-client` datasource. Maps to `vantage_api_client::PaginationParams`. For APIs that page by a 0-based item offset (`?offset=&limit=`, e.g. Launch Library 2) set `offset_based: true`; for 1-based page indexes (`?_page=&_limit=`) leave it false.

limit_param.description: Query param carrying the page size — e.g. `limit`, `_limit`.

offset_based.description: True when `page_param` is a 0-based item offset (skip) rather than a 1-based page index.

page_param.description: Query param carrying the page (or, when `offset_based`, the item offset) — e.g. `offset`, `_page`, `page`.

GraphQlDialect.description: GraphQL filter-argument rendering style — see `vantage_api_client::FilterDialect`. Lower-cased on the wire to match the rest of the inventory schema (`generic`, `hasura`).

oneOf.description: Flat-argument schemas like SpaceX: `{ field: v }`. Equality only.
Hasura-style: `{ field: { _eq: v } }`, with full operator coverage.

PulseKeyConfig.description: One category the `pulse` effect tracks, with the value it rubber-bands around.

PulseRateConfig.description: The `pulse` effect's per-key update cadence range, as duration strings.
